picks.reasoning: BLG has the better players and a far better record, with Viper carrying the bot lane and 41-10 in LPL play. MKOI's comeback stats are real, but they throw too, and I won't bet against the stronger individuals on a coin-flip-style read.

Tempo favors BLG: +1.4k at 15 against MKOI's +0.6k, and they convert 9 of 10 leads, so if they set the early pace they rarely let it slip. MKOI's comeback history and 60% dragon control keep this from being a lock.

Drafts decide this one, and BLG's pool is deeper: Yunara and Lulu are six picks each, and their LPL-level 9/10 lead conversion should punish MKOI if they fall behind in the draft. MKOI's comeback edge is real, but their EWC 0-2 and BLG's 1-0 head-to-head point the same way.

BLG's 2026 series record (50-12), the 1-0 head-to-head, and a 14-6 last-20 stretch point clearly toward them, but MKOI's 4 comeback wins and the gap between regions keep this from being a lock. I'm leaning BLG without much conviction beyond what the numbers show.

BLG's locker room looks settled and confident, and their 14-6 run with a strong LPL and 8-2 record against other regions suggests a team that trusts each other when it matters. I'm watching their habit of throwing leads, since MKOI has the comeback poise to exploit that, but I still think BLG's mood and chemistry carry them through.
